name: The Westin Grande Sukhumvit
positioning: The Westin Grande Sukhumvit, Bangkok: a city hotel beside the BTS Asok Skytrain station, with a saltwater pool overlooking the skyline and the Vareena Spa
best_for: Travelers who want direct Skytrain and subway access in central Sukhumvit
Business and leisure guests who want club lounge access, a spa and a skyline pool

facts.text: Terminal 21 Asok, with local designers and international labels, is nearby.
Benjakitti Forest Park, for strolling or cycling, is a few steps from the hotel.
The pool deck has lounge chairs and spacious cabanas.
The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio has LifeFitness cardio and strength machines, plus a Run Concierge.
Rooms have the Westin Heavenly Bed, Lavender Balm and White Tea bath products.
Kisso offers refined Japanese dining with menus that evolve with ingredients sourced from Japan.
Zest Bar & Terrace on an upper floor has views of downtown Bangkok and live music.

highlights.text: The hotel is directly adjacent to the BTS Asok Skytrain station and steps from the MRT Sukhumvit subway station.
The 8th-floor outdoor saltwater pool overlooks the Bangkok skyline, with an adjacent Pool Bar for sunset cocktails.
Vareena Spa, named for the Thai word for water, has a hydrotherapy room, Vichy shower, aroma steam room and VIP spa suite.
The spa has a wooden floor, lantern-like lighting, nature-inspired patterns and native Thai details such as wooden screens.
Executive Club rooms and suites include Westin Club Lounge access with breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
Suvarnabhumi Airport is 30 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the location is in the busy, high-traffic Sukhumvit area.
